General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging

What is This Part?
This is the complete Tailgate Handle Assembly.
This connects to your tailgate and restores the ability to easily open the tailgate.
It even comes with the cap that covers the screw hole.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 Screw Hole cap
Qty 1 Tailgate Handle Cover
Qty 1 Tailgate Handle
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
